class.name: PlayFabLeaderboards
class.description: Accessed through [code]PlayFab.leaderboards[/code]. All leaderboard methods require a signed-in [PlayFabUser] and return completion [Signal] values awaited directly.

method.name: submit_score_async
method.description: Submits the score payload for the specified [param user] to the named leaderboard. The completed result data contains the submitted leaderboard name, local id, entity key, and score values.

method.name: get_leaderboard_async
method.description: Queries a page of leaderboard rows for the specified [param user].

method.name: get_leaderboard_around_user_async
method.description: Queries leaderboard rows centered around the specified [param user].

method.name: get_friend_leaderboard_async
method.description: Compatibility entry point for friend leaderboards. [param include_xbox_friends] maps [code]false[/code] to [constant FRIEND_SOURCE_NONE] and [code]true[/code] to [constant FRIEND_SOURCE_XBOX], preserving the original defaults and result shape. New code that selects external platforms should use [method get_friend_leaderboard_with_sources_async].

method.name: get_friend_leaderboard_with_sources_async
method.description: Queries the friend leaderboard while selecting which external friend providers PlayFab should include. [constant FRIEND_SOURCE_NONE] requests only the PlayFab friend list. Ordinary provider flags can be combined, for example [code]FRIEND_SOURCE_STEAM | FRIEND_SOURCE_XBOX[/code]. [constant FRIEND_SOURCE_ALL] is a distinct service selector and must be used alone; it is not the same as combining the four named providers. Steam, Facebook, and PSN selections require the corresponding provider integration and linked or authenticated account to have been established separately. Selections containing [constant FRIEND_SOURCE_XBOX], including [constant FRIEND_SOURCE_ALL], require an Xbox-backed PlayFab session created with [method PlayFabUsers.sign_in_with_xuser_async]. Invalid masks complete with [code]invalid_friend_sources[/code]. The completed [PlayFabResult] has the same data shape as other leaderboard reads: [code]rankings[/code], [code]entry_count[/code], [code]version[/code], and optional [code]next_reset[/code].

constants.constant: Request no additional external friend providers. The PlayFab friend list can still contribute results.
Include Steam friends for an appropriately configured and linked Steam account.
Include Facebook friends for an account with the required provider integration.
Include Xbox friends. This requires an Xbox-backed PlayFab session and acquires the Xbox token required by PlayFab.
Include PlayStation Network friends for an account with the required provider integration.
Request PlayFab's distinct [code]All[/code] selector. Use this value alone. The addon treats it as including Xbox, so it requires an Xbox-backed PlayFab session.
